question: Why is there a strange pattern on Robin's breast, who has grown into a giant bloom? I was looking forward to it... but this is the second time I've felt such resentment. I will not forgive you.
answer: I'm... I'm so angry...!! The first time was when Black Maria wrapped her in a bleached cloak......! I received a lot of angry comments about this. First of all, I will explain that the matter of Black's Maria's exposure is "spider thread". As for Robin... Well, it's possible to make clothes out of parts of Robin's body, but when she's that size, I thought I'd have to put in the extra effort to imitate her clothes, but if she's naked, it goes beyond the scope of a shonen manga. The answer that Robin-san and I gave was that pattern! What the hell is that? We are waiting for everyone's views at SBS!! What the hell!
